title: Back a Contri savings circle
description: Puts USDT from this treasury's NEAR Intents balance behind a member savings circle on Contri. It covers missed payments that a member's deposit can't. What is left comes back to this treasury when the circle ends.

fields.name: circle
fields.label: Circle number
fields.help: The circle's number, from its address in Contri (contri.ng/app#/c/<number>)

fields.name: amount
fields.label: Amount in USDT base units
fields.help: 1 USDT = 1000000. At least one contribution of the circle.

summary: Back Contri circle {{circle}} with {{amount}} USDT base units
